irs-5472.notes: Due with the tax return. The PDF did not include the disregarded-entity filing note; the instructions page is the source for where to send it.

destination.evidence: U.S. companies are exempt from the BOI reporting requirements; reports are filed through the BOI E-Filing System.

fincen-boir.notes: U.S.-formed companies (including a Chinese-owned Delaware or Texas LLC) are exempt. Only entities formed under foreign law and registered to do business in a U.S. state may need to file; confirm against the August 2026 final rule. Do not put this in a plan for a U.S. LLC.

destination.evidence: A responsible person must sign Section L; the name and SSN or ITIN must match Section K. Unsigned applications are returned.

ny-dtf-17.notes: Apply at least 20 days before the first taxable sale; don't sell until the Certificate of Authority arrives. No fee stated. Online through NY Business Express is the usual route. Section K asks for SSNs: Placetta never sends them; the person enters them.

destination.evidence: Create an account in the AB+C Portal (abc.austintexas.gov) and submit through the Commercial Building Permit Web Form; once the invoice is paid, review starts.

aus-building.notes: Small projects under 10,000 sq ft (including change of use) are reviewed in 5 business days; fees are not refundable.
